_about: Labeled Tier-3 unstructured-MENTION eval set for resolve_tier3 (cross-source-entity-resolution.md §5). MIRRORS entity_pairs.json in spirit, but each case is one UNSTRUCTURED CHUNK (a Drive/Linear body) plus the gazetteer context needed to resolve its mentions, and the EXPECTED Tier-3 outcome per mention. The load-bearing property is precision-of-DECISION-B (which entity): an ambiguous 'Acme' with two candidates must resolve to NIL/abstain (never a guess), and a mention may only become a TAG when a deterministic co-signal (or human) corroborates an already-folded canonical. A free-text mention with NO co-signal and auto_link off is a REVIEWER_HINT only (non-authoritative). 'expect' per mention is one of: nil, abstain_margin, reviewer_hint, tag. The gazetteer is shared per case via 'catalog'. 'config' overrides Tier3Config defaults (tau_nil/margin_delta/auto_link_tier3) when a case needs a specific operating point.

chunk.text: Repro confirmed for Acme's timeout on the pricing export.

cases.rationale: Single confident candidate (exact surface 'Acme' -> account:acme), wide margin, and an ACL domain co-signal (acme.com == the folded canonical's verified domain) on the SAME chunk. Decision B resolves AND the §5 tag gate clears -> TAG. The tag NARROWS D9 to Acme-scope (safe under intersection); the ACL co-signal only permits it, it never grants visibility.

chunk.text: Kickoff call with Acme went well; follow up next week.

cases.rationale: TWO catalog entities share the surface form 'Acme' (acme-corp vs acme-freight). No co-signal separates them, so top1-top2 = 0 < margin_delta -> ABSTAIN_MARGIN. The load-bearing abstain gate: guessing which Acme would mis-file content into a real customer's scope. Quarantine, NEVER a guess, NEVER the zero-tag bucket.

Single confident candidate but NO deterministic co-signal (the Linear org id is your workspace, the actor email is the wrong population) and auto_link_tier3 is off (default). So the mention is a REVIEWER HINT only: non-authoritative tier=3 evidence surfaces in the review queue ('ENG-42 possibly concerns account:acme, unconfirmed') but the chunk is NOT tagged and NOT dumped into zero-tag. A human confirm would flip it to a tag; a reject would anti-link it.

chunk.text: Renewal notes for Globex — see the SOW at globex.io/contract for terms.

cases.rationale: The co-signal is in the BODY (globex.io), not the ACL — a domain in the chunk text matching the candidate's verified domain is deterministic corroboration. Confident, unambiguous, co-signed, already-folded canonical -> TAG.

chunk.text: Initech asked about the initech.com SSO integration timeline.

cases.rationale: Confident, co-signed mention BUT the target is NOT yet a folded canonical (is_canonical=false). The §5 tag gate requires an already-folded canonical, so even with a co-signal this is a REVIEWER_HINT, never a tag. Tier-3 never forms the canonical itself.

chunk.text: Notes from the Zorp Robotics onboarding — unrelated to any account.

cases.rationale: The only org named ('Zorp Robotics') is not in the gazetteer, so detection finds no gazetteer mention (and the deterministic default detector adds none). No mentions -> nothing to disambiguate -> no evidence. The safe default: an unknown org is never force-fit to a catalog entity.

Same free-text mention as m-0003 (no co-signal, auto_link off) BUT a human already confirmed account:acme for this chunk. A human confirmation is the §5 'or a human approves' branch AND overrides the auto-off kill switch -> TAG. Proves the human backstop, not a threshold, is what turns a hint into a tag here.

chunk.text: Hooli expansion plan for Q3 — see attached deck.

cases.rationale: When a tenant opts INTO auto_link_tier3 (a public spec amendment, §8), a confident + co-signed + already-folded mention TAGs without a human. Exercises the kill-switch ON path. Still non-authoritative at the fold: raises confidence / materializes a narrowing tag, never forms an edge.

chunk.text: Massive quarterly dynamic pricing review across all regions.

cases.rationale: 'Massive' and 'dynamic' appear as separate common words, not the company name 'Massive Dynamic' as a contiguous span. The word-boundary window pass finds no exact surface form, and no co-signal exists, so any weak fuzzy candidate falls below tau_nil -> NIL / no mention emitted. Guards against generic-word false positives.

chunk.text: Catering contract with Los Pollos Hermanos finalized; invoices to lospolloshermanos.com.

cases.rationale: Multi-word surface form 'Los Pollos Hermanos' must be detected as one contiguous span (the window pass), then co-signed by the body domain -> confident + co-signed + folded canonical -> TAG. Exercises multi-token detection.
